calls.statement:
WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-06-01' AS start_date, DATE '2026-06-28' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT store_id, SUM(net_sales) AS ctl_net, COUNT(*) AS ctl_days FROM rpt_daily_store_sales, params
    WHERE business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND store_id < 900 GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS per_day, c.ctl_net, ss.net_sales - c.ctl_net AS gap, c.ctl_days
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
LEFT JOIN ctl c ON c.store_id = ss.store_id
ORDER BY rank

WITH l AS (
  SELECT f.*, s.store_id, d.is_trading_day
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
  WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28' AND s.store_id<900
)
SELECT 'rows' AS chk, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d2 FROM l
UNION ALL SELECT 'closed_day_sales', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT store_id), 0 FROM l WHERE NOT is_trading_day
UNION ALL SELECT 'kuopio_in_closure', COUNT(*), 0, 0 FROM l WHERE store_id=125 AND sale_date>=DATE '2026-06-15'
UNION ALL SELECT 'test999_or_zz', COUNT(*), 0, 0 FROM l JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=l.product_key WHERE p.category='ZZ Test'
UNION ALL SELECT 'stores_in_dim_current', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT store_id), 0 FROM dim_store WHERE is_current AND store_id<900
UNION ALL SELECT 'ret_dups', COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id), 0 FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-01' AND DATE '2026-06-28'
